# Westchester Cleaning Services, LLC

> Commercial janitorial and cleaning company serving Westchester County, NY. MBE-certified, in business for over a decade. Trusted by offices, multifamily buildings, medical practices, gyms, and retail spaces.

## About

Westchester Cleaning Services, LLC is a licensed and fully insured commercial cleaning company headquartered in Tarrytown, New York. Founded over 10 years ago, the company is a certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) through the New York State MWBE program. The company serves businesses, property managers, condo boards, and co-op boards throughout Westchester County.

- Legal name: Westchester Cleaning Services, LLC

## Service Area

All of Westchester County, NY — including White Plains, Yonkers, New Rochelle, Mount Vernon, Tarrytown, Scarsdale, Rye, Mamaroneck, Ossining, Peekskill, Port Chester, and surrounding communities.

## Credentials

- Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) — NY State Empire State Development MWBE Program
- HUD vendor
- Fully insured — certificates of insurance available on request
